tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page background (warm off-white by day, near-black by night).

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Raised ground: menu cards, info cards.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Pressed or nested fills, image placeholders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, icons and control borders.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, captions, meta text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dotted menu leaders only.

tokens.name: chile
tokens.usage: Brand orange-red for text and fills on the page (prices, links, primary buttons). Deepened from the sign's orange so it passes 4.5:1 on the off-white ground.

tokens.name: chile-deep
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of chile fills and links.

tokens.name: on-chile
tokens.usage: Text and icons on chile fills.

tokens.name: queso
tokens.usage: Queso yellow: the N disc, stars, 'Order now' highlight, sun-burst backgrounds. Never text on cream — it is a fill.

tokens.name: on-queso
tokens.usage: Text and icons on queso fills (9.7:1).

tokens.name: nopal
tokens.usage: Salsa-verde green: 'Fresh / veggie' tags, open-now status, accents in papel picado. Text-safe on surface-000/100.

tokens.name: on-nopal
tokens.usage: Text on nopal fills.

tokens.name: jamaica
tokens.usage: Hibiscus magenta reserved for aguas frescas and drink specials. Accent only — never a primary action.

tokens.name: on-jamaica
tokens.usage: Text on jamaica fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px focus ring, 2px offset; overridden on dark grounds.

tokens.name: sign
tokens.usage: The sign's orange-red, sampled by eye from photos (confirm exact value with the family). Use on the black hero ground and for large type only — not for body text on off-white.

tokens.name: hero-ground
tokens.usage: The black of their signage: hero and marquee ground in both themes.

tokens.name: on-hero
tokens.usage: Text on hero-ground.

styles.name: script-hero
styles.usage: The name and one-word shouts only (amor, ¡Órale!). Max one per screen; pair with a hard ink drop shadow.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline, set in ALL CAPS.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Kickers above headlines, tags, nav links. ALL CAPS.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Family-owned, smashed to order, served with love.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 4oz smash patty, special sauce, caramelized onions, American cheese, pickles.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Prices may vary on delivery apps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label nudge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner gap; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between menu cards; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, menu cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero panels, photo frames, app icon corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Flavor chips, sticker badges, status pills.

shadow.note: Hard, offset, no blur — like a sign-painter's drop shade or a sticker. Never soft drop shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Cards, hero panels, primary buttons at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, chips, buttons on hover (button moves 2px toward the shadow).

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: Card and sticker outlines in ink.

tokens.name: border-thin
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags.
